title: Public Problem Probes
description: Externally recognizable bounded math problems used to test whether Truth Harness can turn public prompts into local receipts without overclaiming. Initial sources: Project Euler Problems 1, 2, and 6.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 1: Multiples of 3 or 5
tasks.aiFailureMode: Gives the known answer without a replayable local certificate or inclusion-exclusion trace.
tasks.prompt: Find the sum of all the multiples of 3 or 5 below 1000.
requiredEvidence: inclusion-exclusion trace for multiples of 3, 5, and 15
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only explicit positive-integer multiple sums below a finite positive bound are supported. This is deterministic computation, not a formal proof of arbitrary combinatorics.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 1: Multiples of 3 or 5
tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a near-miss public benchmark answer without recomputing the exact finite sum.
tasks.prompt: verify sum of multiples of 3 or 5 below 1000 = 233169
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated finite multiple-sum equality is refuted; this does not evaluate unrelated Project Euler problems.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 2: Even Fibonacci Numbers
tasks.aiFailureMode: Returns a memorized public answer without a replayable recurrence trace.
tasks.prompt: Find the sum of even Fibonacci terms not exceeding 4000000.
requiredEvidence: even-term list under the explicit bound
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the standard Fibonacci sequence seeded by 1 and 2 with an explicit finite positive bound is supported.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 2: Even Fibonacci Numbers
tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a near-miss recurrence sum without replaying the sequence.
tasks.prompt: verify sum of even Fibonacci terms not exceeding 4000000 = 4613733
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated bounded recurrence-sum equality is refuted; this does not evaluate arbitrary recurrence claims.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 6: Sum Square Difference
tasks.aiFailureMode: Confuses sum of squares with square of sum or returns a known answer without formulas.
tasks.prompt: Find the difference between the square of the sum and the sum of squares for the first 100 natural numbers.
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only square-of-sum minus sum-of-squares for the first n natural numbers with explicit positive integer n is supported.

tasks.sourceTitle: Project Euler Problem 6: Sum Square Difference
tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a one-off arithmetic slip in a public finite-sum problem.
tasks.prompt: verify difference between square of sum and sum of squares for first 100 natural numbers = 25164151
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated bounded finite-sum equality is refuted; this does not prove arbitrary summation identities.
